faq.description: How genetics, longevity and financial planning fit together.
faq.title: Questions about Bioanalytix

dnaLifespan.question: Can my DNA tell me how long I will live?
dnaLifespan.answer: No. Longevity is influenced by genetics, health, behaviour, environment and other factors. Bioanalytix does not predict an individual's lifespan with certainty. Genetic evidence can help inform which longevity questions and planning scenarios may be relevant.

longevityPlanning.question: Why does longevity matter to my financial plan?
longevityPlanning.answer: Retirement, spending, wealth and estate plans all depend on assumptions about how long financial resources may need to last. Bioanalytix helps make those assumptions explicit so you can explore the financial consequences of different longevity scenarios.

existingDna.question: I already have DNA results. Can I use them?
existingDna.answer: Yes. Bioanalytix Individual lets you bring supported genetic data into your profile. Bioanalytix uses governed genetic evidence to identify health, longevity and resilience questions that may be relevant to long-term planning.

needDnaTest.question: What if I have never had a DNA test?
needDnaTest.answer: You can start with Bioanalytix Free without DNA and build your financial planning foundation first. We also plan to provide a pathway for users who want to arrange compatible DNA testing through Bioanalytix.

professionalAdvice.question: Does Bioanalytix provide medical or financial advice?
professionalAdvice.answer: No. Bioanalytix provides analytical information and planning tools. It does not diagnose disease, provide medical advice, determine financial decisions or replace appropriately qualified professional advice.

individualPlan.question: What do I get with Bioanalytix Individual?
individualPlan.answer: Individual adds DNA upload and a governed genetic profile, personalised research evidence and genetics-informed planning context to the Bioanalytix financial planning experience. The current plan includes a 7-day free trial.

hero.title: Your financial plan assumes how long you'll live. What if it knew more about you?
hero.subtitle: Your genetics can contain evidence relevant to longevity, health risk and biological resilience. Bioanalytix brings that evidence into long-term financial planning — helping you explore how different longevity scenarios could affect retirement, wealth and estate decisions.
hero.noDnaRequired: Already have DNA results? Bring them with you. No DNA yet? You can still start free.

features.title: Start with your finances. Add your biology when it adds value.
